findings.title: Container writes to a read-only volume
findings.cause: container web exits because it writes to /data/started, which is read-only: the mount of volume data at /data sets readOnly: true; its log says: "sh: can't create /data/started: Read-only file system"; Deployment web has 0 of 1 replicas ready

evidence.what: container web exited with code 1 (Error), restarted 6 times
last lines of container web's log (run that exited)
evidence.detail: sh: can't create /data/started: Read-only file system

evidence.what: container web mounts volume data (emptyDir) at /data with readOnly: true

findings.fix: Remove readOnly: true from the mount of volume data at /data if the container is meant to write there, or point the app at a writable volume.
